    n &= ~(1 << 0); // Clear the first bit
    n &= ~(1 << 31); // Clear the last bit

    n ^= (1 << 1); // Toggle the second bit
    n ^= (1 << 2); // Toggle the third bit
    n ^= (1 << 4); // Toggle the fourth bit
    n ^= (1 << 5); // Toggle the fifth bit

    n ^= (1 << 13); // Toggle the thirteenth bit
